name: Metabase
tagline: The simplest, fastest way to get business intelligence and analytics to everyone in your company
description:
# Metabase

The simplest, fastest way to get business intelligence and analytics to everyone in your company

Metabase is the easy, open-source way for everyone in your company to ask questions and learn from data.

## App Links

<https://www.metabase.com>

<https://github.com/metabase/metabase>

<https://hub.docker.com/r/metabase/metabase>

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  metabase:
    container_name: metabase
    image: metabase/metabase:v0.64.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:3000
    environment:
      - MGID=${GID-1000}
      - MB_DB_FILE=/metabase-data/metabase.db
      - JAVA_TIMEZONE=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/metabase/data:/metabase-data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/metabase/plugins:/plugins
